Name: SuanNi-Custom NPC - English Translation
Author: simendf90
Description:
English translation i made of the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25277?tab=description]SuanNi-Custom NPC[/url]﻿ made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158292023]SuanNiBaiRou[/url]﻿

It is a standalone mod, so you dont need the original as of now.

Much credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/158292023]SuanNiBaiRou[/url]﻿ for making such an amazing NPC mod :)

I got permission to upload this translated mod to Nexusmods by SuanNiBaiRou.

Downloads.Description:
Added the new festival lines from the newest update and fixed the translation on the 4 heart event.
If you are updating this mod from the 1.0 version, you need to delete the old folder first because i changed the name on the folder to match the original.
